_note: M2-ARC-08: how long the boot card (BootCard) and the router's reveal hold (SceneRouter._wait_for_reveal) wait for the boot warm-up. They wait while the work reports progress (ProgressWait). They give up on a stall: stall_timeout_ms with no progress. max_wait_ms is an absolute safety cap, far above any first launch measured (9.5 s on Low, RX 9070 XT, M1-RND-29). On a stall or the cap, the card stops the warm-up (ShaderPrewarm.cancel) before it lifts, so nothing stages under the title.

cue._note: The first-launch cue: one quiet line and a thin progress bar near the bottom of the card, only while ShaderPrewarm.first_run is staging. It appears after delay_ms, so a fast first launch shows nothing, and fades in over fade_in_ms.
